title: add transactional downgrade guard + backup/restore + rollback tooling for private installer
author: Samir Patel
body: Motivation: Private deployments need safe, observable upgrade semantics. Customers upgrading on-prem or in VPC have experienced issues when schema migrations and component version mismatches occur. This PR introduces a transactional downgrade guard, explicit version pinning support, improved backup/restore hooks, and a rollback tooling path surfaced via the installer and Helm/Terraform modules. Summary of changes: - transactional downgrade guard: atomic marker+lock approach to prevent accidental downgrade when schema versions mismatch; aborts upgrade if checks fail. - version pinning: support for an installer config field `pinnedImages` and chart values `image.tagPinned` that stops auto-latest rollouts for critical components. - backup/restore: pre-migration backup hooks for Postgres and object store, with verification step and idempotent restore runner. - schema migrations: convert existing migrations to transactional (where supported) and add a safe rollback migration plan for each breaking migration. - rollback tooling: `redwood-installer rollback` command that runs verify checks, restores backups, and rolls images back to pinned versions; integrates with Terraform state and Helm rollbacks. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked in Linear ENG-4821 - [x] unit tests for migration guard - [x] e2e upgrade test with a local postgres instance - [x] manual dry-run on staging cluster - [x] added release notes This description is a single continuous string containing the motivation, implementation summary, and rollout plan. The release plan below details steps to roll out to customers with minimal risk.

review_comments: Ava Chen (reviewer): Can you explain the failure modes where the transactional guard triggers and how operators observe it?

Samir Patel (author): The guard verifies schema version and component image compatibility. If versions are incompatible it emits a clear event and metric `upgrade_guard.check_failures` and aborts. The runbook section describes remediation and how to force-proceed with --unsafe-override.
Diego Martinez (reviewer): We should ensure backups are not taken if PVC capacity is under threshold to avoid partial backups.
Samir Patel (author): Added capacity check to pg_backup_runner.sh and a warning in the installer dry-run output.
Priya Rao (reviewer): Does terraform state store the pinned image tags securely? Any leakage risk?

Samir Patel (author): Terraform module persists only the image tag string; we intentionally avoid putting credentials into state. Added note in docs and a follow-up Linear ENG-4902 to add state encryption guidance.

Pre-migration backup and verification hooks added. New `redwood-installer rollback` command for safe rollbacks. See docs/upgrade-rollout.md for runbook and rollback procedures.
